note: Mono goal 2026-10-29 (PLAN.md): what the Mono script engine costs on the sim thread, and the trial offload pieces on the current build. asi rel020 = ts3native 0.36.105 = master native source (no native change since 24c51af3; a fresh master build differs from rel020 only in 7 PE timestamp/checksum bytes, selftest ok 2026-10-29). Every job = repo ini (v0.2.x release defaults, every Mono switch off) + the job's Mono keys + [HitchAttr] (light, for the sim-budget waits bucket). Jobs re-pinned from mono-ledger-probe.json, mono-m5-probe.json, autshadow-first.json and mono-night.json (10-20/10-21 notes and pass rules kept). Order: ledger probe (0.36.7 loop-back fix, never rerun), [MonoThread] gates-off, idle worker, [AutShadow] count bp+ip, Mode R bp+ip. Stop the queue on any crash (crash-cause-before-fix: our Mono code until proven otherwise). Samplers are on in every job (the Mono bucket needs managed samples): ms/s are measurement numbers, not an A/B; compare with the release baseline of the same night (sim-budget-v024.json). Ledger and gates-off are correctness (noiseCheck false); the 5 cost jobs are 50 timing minutes (< SMOKE_OVER_MIN, no smoke). ~13-14 min per job, ~95 min. Report: node tools/harness/mono-cost-report.ts probe-out/queue/mono-cost-<date>.jsonl
